title.en: Events Division · KKN Digimapan Community Service

location.id: Desa Lebak Wangi, Kec. Sepatan Timur, Kab. Tangerang
location.en: Lebak Wangi Village, East Sepatan, Tangerang Regency

participants.id: Siswa SD / Madrasah Desa Lebak Wangi
participants.en: Elementary / Madrasah Students of Lebak Wangi Village

impact.id: Menginisiasi dan menjalankan kelas literasi digital dasar dengan praktik langsung Typingcore dan Microsoft Paint.
impact.en: Initiated and delivered foundational digital literacy classes with hands-on Typingcore and Microsoft Paint practice.

lines.id: Bertugas di Divisi Acara KKN Digimapan ITB Ahmad Dahlan di Desa Lebak Wangi, Kec. Sepatan Timur, Kab. Tangerang.
lines.en: Served in the Events Division of ITB Ahmad Dahlan's KKN Digimapan in Lebak Wangi Village, East Sepatan, Tangerang.

lines.id: Mengusulkan dan menyusun modul program literasi digital untuk siswa SD memakai Typingcore dan Microsoft Paint agar siswa terbiasa mengoperasikan papan ketik serta kursor.
lines.en: Proposed and structured a digital literacy program for elementary students using Typingcore and Microsoft Paint to build keyboard and mouse fluency.

relevance.id: Menerjemahkan konsep teknis menjadi langkah bertahap yang mudah dipahami audiens non-teknis — keterampilan komunikasi yang esensial saat mempresentasikan temuan data kepada pemangku kepentingan.
relevance.en: Translating technical concepts into approachable step-by-step guidance for non-technical audiences — an essential communication skill when presenting data insights to stakeholders.

tasks.id: Merancang susunan acara dan jadwal pelaksanaan kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat KKN Digimapan ITB Ahmad Dahlan di Desa Lebak Wangi.
tasks.en: Designed event rundowns and execution schedules for ITB Ahmad Dahlan's KKN Digimapan community service in Lebak Wangi Village.

tasks.id: Mengusulkan program literasi digital tingkat Sekolah Dasar menggunakan Typingcore (latihan mengetik 10 jari dasar) dan Microsoft Paint (kontrol kursor & visual).
tasks.en: Proposed an elementary digital literacy program using Typingcore (basic typing practice) and Microsoft Paint (cursor & visual control).

tasks.id: Memfasilitasi pendampingan kelompok kecil secara bergiliran agar setiap siswa mendapatkan pengalaman praktik langsung di perangkat laptop.
tasks.en: Facilitated rotating small-group mentoring so every student received direct hands-on practice on a laptop.

result.id: Program literasi digital terlaksana dengan partisipasi aktif siswa di kelas dan mendokumentasikan peningkatan kelancaran penggunaan perangkat dasar.
result.en: Successfully delivered the digital literacy program with active classroom participation and documented smoother basic device operation among students.

participants.id: Pengelola Administrasi, Guru & Calon Orang Tua Murid

impact.id: Efisiensi administrasi sekolah meningkat hingga 50% melalui digitalisasi data guru dan silabus.
impact.en: School administrative efficiency increased by up to 50% through teacher data and syllabus digitization.

lines.id: Merancang dan membangun website landing page serta Content Management System (CMS) untuk informasi sekolah, mencakup manajemen konten dinamis, data guru, dan kurikulum mata pelajaran.
lines.en: Designed and built a landing page website and Content Management System (CMS) for school information, covering dynamic content management, teacher records, and subject curriculum.

lines.id: Meningkatkan efisiensi administrasi sekolah hingga 50% melalui digitalisasi pendataan profil guru dan silabus kegiatan.
lines.en: Improved school administration efficiency by up to 50% through the digitization of teacher profile records and activity syllabi.

lines.id: Mengembangkan tampilan website yang responsif di perangkat mobile dan desktop untuk mempermudah calon orang tua murid mengakses informasi sekolah.
lines.en: Developed a responsive web interface across mobile and desktop devices so prospective parents can easily access school information.

relevance.id: Merapikan pencatatan manual profil guru dan silabus kegiatan ke dalam skema database CMS yang terstruktur — fondasi yang sama dengan proses data cleaning dan normalisasi skema sebelum analisis data.
relevance.en: Restructuring manual teacher records and activity syllabi into a normalized CMS database schema — the exact same foundation as data cleaning and schema structuring prior to data analysis.

tasks.id: Merancang struktur data terpusat dan membangun Content Management System (CMS) untuk mengelola konten dinamis, pendataan profil guru, dan kurikulum mata pelajaran.
tasks.en: Designed a centralized data structure and built a Content Management System (CMS) to manage dynamic content, teacher profile data, and curriculum.

tasks.id: Mengubah proses pendataan profil guru dan silabus kegiatan dari dokumen terpisah menjadi alur input digital terstandar.
tasks.en: Transformed teacher profile and activity syllabus recording from scattered documents into a standardized digital input workflow.

tasks.id: Membangun antarmuka landing page yang responsif di perangkat mobile dan desktop bagi calon orang tua murid.
tasks.en: Built a responsive landing page across mobile and desktop devices for prospective parents.

result.id: Meningkatkan efisiensi administrasi sekolah hingga 50% melalui digitalisasi pendataan profil guru dan silabus kegiatan, sekaligus membuka akses informasi publik 24/7 bagi calon orang tua murid.
result.en: Increased school administrative efficiency by up to 50% by digitizing teacher profiles and activity syllabi, while providing 24/7 public information access for prospective parents.
